entries.partTitle: Spatial Memory Safety vs Temporal Memory Safety

spec.title: Spatial out-of-bounds bounds failure versus temporal lifetime invalidation

left.title: Spatial Safety Violations
items: Operations access memory outside allocated buffer bounds
Out of bounds array indexing and off-by-one errors
Linear memory overwrites corrupting adjacent stack data

right.title: Temporal Safety Violations
items: Operations access memory outside valid object lifetimes
Dereferencing dangling pointers after free or delete
Use-after-free and double-free enabling heap hijacking

steps.caption: Spatial memory safety is violated when operations access out of bounds data.
Temporal memory safety is violated when operations access freed objects.

entries.partTitle: Memory-Safe Architecture: Ownership, Borrow Checking & Rust Safety Invariants

spec.title: Manual pointer lifecycle pitfalls versus Rust compile-time ownership

left.title: Unmanaged Manual Pointers
items: Manual allocation and deallocation via malloc and free
Pointers can easily outlive their allocated object lifetime
Data races and dangling pointers discovered only at runtime

right.title: Rust Compile-Time Ownership
items: Each value has exactly one owner dropped on scope exit
Borrow checker enforces exclusive mutable reference rules
Complete spatial and temporal safety without garbage collector

steps.caption: Rust ownership rules dictate that values are dropped when owners exit scope.
The borrow checker enforces strict rules on mutable and shared references.
